output.reason: The cited bullet [ev-0622452b41d6] is one entry in the "These metrics will be changed" list. The section intro [ev-1f419676f177] says what the change is: in this release, metrics that started with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` instead. So the subject is the metric `cortex_prometheus_rule_group_iterations_total`, and the change is a rename to `loki_prometheus_rule_group_iterations_total`. [ev-1f419676f177] also gives the applicability: environments that leave `metrics_namespace` at its default of `loki` are exposed, while setting it to `cortex` keeps the old name (that setting is deprecated). The consequence of a rename is that anything querying the old `cortex_` name no longer finds the metric, which is enough to write the typed assertion.
